newsitem.title: USA: U.S. machine tool demand $960 mln in September.
newsitem.headline: U.S. machine tool demand $960 mln in September.

text.p: U.S. demand for machine tools was estimated at $960 million in September, the American Machine Tool Distributors' Association and the Association for Manufacturing Technology said Sunday in a joint report.
Machine tool orders in August were estimated at $610.0 million, an AMTDA spokesman said.

Year ago comparisons were not available. The report, the fourth U.S. Machine Tool Consumption report issued by the two associations, replaces monthly data on U.S. machine tool orders, shipments and exports that had been issued by the Association for Manufacturing Technology.
"September's strong consumption reflects the impact of activity from the International Manufacturing Technology Show" held last month, AMTDA President Ralph Nappi said in a statement.

"Even more encouraging is the diverse nature of the activity. Recent investments in capital equipment come from companies, both large and small, within many industry sectors and geographical territories," Nappi added.
Machine tools are used to shape metal in making everything from golf clubs to aircraft. Demand for these tools can provide a leading indicator of the pace of manufacturing.
The report said 3,640 machine tool units were ordered in September, up from 2,872 in August. January-to-September units totalled 27,558.

By region, the report said the Midwest accounted for 45.2 percent of national demand, followed by 23.3 percent in the Northeast. The Central region accounted for 13.3 percent of U.S. demand, the South 9.9 percent and the West 8.4 percent.
Export orders placed with U.S. builders totalled 330 units in September, up from 239 in August. In the first nine months of this year, export orders were 2,322 units, the report said.

The groups said they based their latest estimates on a survey of nearly 300 machine tool manufacturers and distributors representing 63 percent of market share, and then projected the remaining 37 percent of the manufacturers' and distributors' business. Distributors' business includes orders for imported machine tools.
